scenario_description:
Objective: Keep filled balcony trough planters from becoming a wind-driven exterior hazard during Linnea's off-site work block.
Emerging Need: A routine absence and early watch do not yet justify intervention, but a later high-wind warning intersects with known rail-side planter conditions and a closing staffed-entry option.
Decision Context: Stored balcony notes define the gust threshold, planter handling, and no-neighbor/no-code access limits; live records establish absence, weather severity, rostered intake, and cutoff.
Consequence: After intake closes, no planter has fallen, but the unit lacks a timely approved path to move them before evening gusts.

parameter.body: A High Wind Warning is now in effect for downtown Minneapolis from 18:00 to 22:00 today. Forecast gusts are 50-55 mph, with stronger crosswinds possible on upper balconies and exposed corners.
